words.gloss: enemies (those who do not unite in heart)

literal: Like friends good things even if they speak, enemies' words quickly to be understood will be.
translation: Even if those who are hostile speak beneficial things like friends, the true nature of their words will be quickly understood.
modern: நண்பர்களைப் போல நல்ல காரியங்களைச் சொன்னாலும், நம்முடன் மனதால் ஒன்றாத பகைவர்களின் சொற்களின் உண்மைத் தன்மை விரைவில் உணர்ந்து கொள்ளப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the deceptive words of insincere people who pretend to be friends. Even if they offer advice or speak words that seem highly beneficial on the surface, their underlying hostile intent cannot remain hidden. A discerning mind will quickly perceive the true, harmful nature behind their sweet words. The key words 'oṭṭār' (those who do not unite in heart) and 'ollai' (quickly) emphasize that the false nature of an enemy's speech is rapidly exposed to those who are vigilant.
